evaluation.shared_rule: identical update rule at every iteration; no absolute step identity

experiment: MINI Cells Experiment 012 — Shared-Rule Settling Dynamics

interpretation.baseline: Experiment 011 stable checkpoints are free-run with the same step-independent rule to show whether Experiment 012 improves beyond random-depth training alone.
interpretation.next_level: Per-cell event-driven sleeping should only be attempted after a reproducible settling plateau exists.
interpretation.pass: A pass is evidence for bounded settling under an autonomous shared cellular rule, not proof of a unique mathematical fixed point or global convergence.

question: Can a language NCA learn a shared update rule whose state and predictions settle under free-running iterations beyond the trained depth?

training.fixed_point_probe: one additional shared-rule update after each sampled stage depth
training.note: The three probe updates participate in training loss; Experiment 012 tests settling, not lower training cost.
